boundary: Four conditions: every turn cold; repeated prefix without a session-affinity header; repeated prefix with a stable x-claude-code-session-id; stable affinity with a changed leading system line. Three repetitions x three sessions x four turns = 36 requests per condition, 144/144 overall, both-cache flush before every measured turn, ingress /v1/chat/completions, TTFT-any metric. The accepted evidence supports a latency association only.
campaign: Prefix reuse and session-affinity cache study

environment.gpu_visibility: replica A GPUs 0-3, replica B GPUs 4-7
environment.ingress: loopback nginx with session-affine consistent hash on x-claude-code-session-id

evidence_class: sanitized request-level records published under results/cache-affinity/raw/

method.metric: TTFT-any: time to the first streamed output event
